essence: The repha-sound is kindled through the mouths of the channels, pervading below and above.
The splendor merged in the birth-circle holds darkness and light in equal radiance.
Through such gestures, one acts thus upon both moving and unmoving beings.
One should meditate on the power as having the form of a lightning creeper in the fivefold space.
Through the piercing of power-knowledge, known as mental, realization occurs for the great-minded one.
